subject: Rate capacity commitment and feature-gating discussion for FastRetail launch
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FastRetail launch - request for temporary quota uplift & product gating questions

Team,

FastRetail confirmed their seasonal rollout for Oct 10–12 and just sent a revised peak forecast (attached). They are asking for a temporary increase in ingress throughput to avoid throttling during the peak window. Quick summary of asks: 

- Temporary quota uplift to support ~14k RPS (peak) and ~120M tokens/day for a 48-hour window centered on Oct 11.
- Two-week ramp + a 48-hour high-traffic window (they want a warmup starting Oct 3).
- Confirmation on product-level knobs we can enable to reduce token/unit usage without changing customer prompts (e.g., aggressive prefix caching + model quantization to int8 fallback).
- Any feature gating we should toggle (streaming vs buffered responses; function-calls limiting) to keep latency within SLOs.

Questions for product/infra:
1) Can we support the 14k RPS temporary bump on hosted capacity or will this necessitate dedicated capacity for the window?
2) What are the rollback criteria (error rate/latency thresholds) to revoke the uplift automatically?
3) Are the prefix/KV cache changes and the suggested quantized variant available for production in time for Oct 3 warmup?

Attachments: fastretail_peak_forecast_q4.xlsx (forecast), initial MOU (they said legal will sign).

I propose we treat this as a sales-led launch: product/infra scope technical gating and CS to handle runbook during the 48-hour peak. Neha, can you confirm CSM coverage and test plan? David/Karthik, please advise on feasibility and whether we need an INFRA ticket. I'll loop in Elaine at FastRetail as soon as we have a concrete quota commitment.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

--
Attachment: fastretail_peak_forecast_q4.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastRetail launch - request for temporary quota uplift & product gating questions

Marissa — thanks for the clear ask and forecast. A few quick notes from product/runtime: 

- 14k RPS sustained is substantial for hosted; depending on sequence length distribution that token/day number could be the real limiter. We need the sample prompt length distribution from FastRetail (p50/p95/p99).
- Short-term options: 1) temporary quota bump on hosted (fastest) + aggressive autoscaling; 2) dedicated capacity reservation for the 48-hour peak (more predictable but requires commit).
- Feature gating: prefix/KV cache + model variant downgrade (redwood-1-small-int8) should reduce token compute by ~30% on average. We can enable these controls at routing level for the FastRetail route. The int8 variant is validated on our infra but we'd mark it as "experimental" for production — requires an explicit risk acceptance.
- Warmup/rollout: we can support a staged warmup starting Oct 3 if FastRetail agrees to progressively increase traffic by 20% every 48 hours.

Operational asks for infra (David): if we do hosted temporary uplift, we will need a runway to provision additional nodes and to set up a prioritized autoscale policy. Suggest opening INFRA-3321 for resource provisioning and INFRA-3322 for rollback automation.

I'll attach a short runbook draft (feature_gating_runbook.md) with suggestions for toggles and metrics to watch (p99 latency, 5xx rate, token/sec per node). If we need absolute guarantees, recommend dedicated capacity reservation and a short-term commitment from the customer.

Karthik
Principal Product Manager, Serving Runtime

--
Attachment: feature_gating_runbook.md (doc)

From: Elaine Park <elaine@fastretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastRetail launch - request for temporary quota uplift & product gating questions

Hi Marissa/Karthik — thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications from FastRetail: 

- We can provide the prompt length distribution by EOD Wed (sample logs). Expect p50 ~ 25 tokens, p95 ~ 180 tokens, p99 ~ 400 tokens.
- We prefer hosted for speed to market but will entertain a short dedicated reservation if Redwood recommends it as the safer path.
- We'll accept routing-level model downgrade if it keeps UX intact. Please outline any visible differences the customer will see (latency, hallucination risk).
- Legal is attaching the signed MOU for the two-week pilot and the 48-hour high peak clause.

Request: Can Redwood confirm a firm quota uplift commitment (numbers + time window) by Sep 24? We need to finalize load tests and our feature flags.

Elaine Park
Head of Platform Integrations, FastRetail
elaine@fastretail.com

--
Attachment: mou_fastretail_signed.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine@fastretail.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastRetail launch - request for temporary quota uplift & product gating questions

Team — summary and decisions after today's sync: 

1) Commitment: Redwood will grant a hosted temporary quota uplift to support up to 12k RPS peak and 100M tokens/day for the agreed 48-hour window (Oct 10 00:00 UTC — Oct 11 23:59 UTC). This is conditional on: (a) FastRetail completing the staged warmup (20% increases) starting Oct 3, and (b) enabling routing-level model downgrade + prefix caching.

2) Dedicated fallback: If during warmup we see sustained p95 latency > 450ms or 5xx > 0.8% for more than 30 minutes, we trigger a move to dedicated capacity (INFRA-3321 will be the provisioning ticket). David, please prepare a minimal dedicated pool spec (GPU type, node count estimate, cost delta) by Sep 24.

3) Rollback & automation: INFRA-3322 will track automated rollback triggers and runbook actions (scale-down, route throttling, customer notification). Jonas, you own on-call for the window; Neha will manage CS communications and the test run schedule.

4) Legal & billing: we will apply a temporary surge rate for the 48-hour window; Marissa to finalize commercial terms with FastRetail (use deal FR-2027-09-07-01). Legal: the signed MOU has been received.

5) Deliverables & deadlines:
- David: infra spec + INFRA-3321/3322 created by Sep 24.
- Karthik: feature toggle implementation plan (prefix cache + int8 fallback) and risk notes by Sep 24.
- Neha: customer test plan and two-week warmup schedule by Sep 25.
- Marissa: finalize commercial terms and send formal quota confirmation to Elaine by Sep 24 EOD.

I've attached the infra runbook stub (infra_temp_quota_runbook.pdf) and the forecast. Once the infra tickets are created, I'll update the HubSpot deal and forward links to FastRetail.

Thanks all — let's treat this as high priority and call out blockers early.

Marissa
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: infra_temp_quota_runbook.pdf (pdf), fastretail_peak_forecast_q4.xlsx (spreadsheet)
